subject: POC kickoff & weekly check-ins — Acme Industries
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Asha Patel <asha.patel@acme.com>, Carlos Mendoza <carlos.mendoza@acme.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC kickoff & weekly check-ins — Acme Industries

Hi Asha / Carlos — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have shared alignment going into the trial:

POC goal / success criteria
- Validate 95th-percentile latency < 350ms for chat endpoint on your representative traffic
- Reduce per-token inference cost by >= 30% vs your baseline through batching and cache configs
- No data leakage; logs retained per your retention policy (30 days)

Evaluation plan
- Use three representative workloads: support chat, knowledge base Q&A, and batch embedding import
- We’ll set up a 2-week trial with daily load injections during business hours and two concentrated peak windows

Timeline & milestones
- Kickoff: week of Jul 5 (proposed: Jul 7) — environment access, account setup, success criteria sign-off
- Week 1: integration + baseline measurements; first weekly check-in (Fri, Jul 9)
- Week 2: performance tuning + final readout prep; final readout (Fri, Jul 16)

Owners
- Redwood: Marissa (sales / program lead), Vivek (solutions engineer / runtime & infra), Rachel (customer success)
- Acme: Asha (POC owner), Carlos (eng lead)

Immediate next steps
1) Asha — confirm kickoff date and provide service account/SSO details by EOD Thu Jul 1
2) Redwood — share success_criteria workbook and a draft runbook (attached)
3) Schedule a recurring 30-min weekly check-in (Fridays)

Attachments: Redwood_POC_Success_Criteria.xlsx (success criteria + runbook)

Thanks — I’ll coordinate invites after I hear back on the kickoff date.

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

From: Asha Patel <asha.patel@acme.com>

Thanks Marissa — this looks great and aligns with what we discussed. A few quick notes:

- Success criteria: the latency target looks reasonable; can you add a variant for 99th-percentile so we can track tail behavior?
- Evaluation plan: we'll also include a small dataset of anonymized user transcripts for semantic quality checks (we'll share by Jul 2)
- Timeline: Jul 7 works for kickoff — Carlos and I are available in the morning (10–11am PT) or late afternoon (3–4pm PT).

We’ve attached our security questionnaire that you might need to loop in security for. Also, for the service account, we’ll send SSO metadata and a short allowlist for IPs by EOD tomorrow.

Asha

Thanks Asha — adding a 99th-percentile line item to the workbook now. Couple of notes from the infra side:

- Engineers: I’ll be the technical lead from Redwood and will bring in two SREs for the initial integration (Rachel and Neha will help run checks and validation steps).
- Access: once we have the service account/SSO metadata we’ll provision the test environment and send a verification checklist (expected turnaround 24–48 hours).
- Weekly cadence: propose a 30-min check-in every Friday at 9am PT starting Jul 9 (we can move if your preferred time is Fri 3pm).

I’ll send calendar invites for the kickoff slot Monday with a short agenda (account setup, baseline run, questions).

— Vivek

- Introductions & scope review (10m)
- Access & environment verification (10–15m)
- Baseline run & quick sanity checks (10–15m)
- Next steps & owner assignments (5m)

- Redwood: Marissa (program lead), Vivek (tech lead), Rachel (validation + check-ins), Neha (SRE tasks)

Best,
Marissa
